articles.title: India's Young People Lead 'Cockroach' Protests Over Jobs and Education
articles.summary: Young people across India have been organising large protests about two big problems: not enough jobs and unhappiness with education policies. The movement got its unusual name after a government official rudely compared unemployed young people to cockroaches. Instead of being offended, protesters embraced the nickname and turned it into a symbol of their movement. India's ruling political party, the BJP, is now worried about losing the support of young voters. While officials are trying new ways to communicate with young people, police have also been arresting some protest leaders. The situation shows how powerful young voices can be in shaping a country's future.

lv1: What did the protesters in India nickname their movement, and why? (印度示威者為他們的運動起了什麼外號？為什麼？)
What are the two main things young people in India are unhappy about? (印度年輕人主要對哪兩件事感到不滿？)
lv2: Why do you think young people chose to use the word 'cockroach' as a symbol of strength rather than an insult? (你認為年輕人為何選擇把「蟑螂」這個字變成力量的象徵，而不是接受它作為侮辱？)
How might high youth unemployment affect a country's future development? (青年失業率高企會如何影響一個國家的未來發展？)
lv3: Should governments listen more carefully to young people's opinions about education and jobs? What challenges might this create for policymakers? (政府是否應該更認真聆聽年輕人對教育和就業的意見？這對政策制定者可能帶來什麼挑戰？)
When police arrest peaceful protest leaders, does this help or harm democracy? Consider arguments from both the government's and protesters' perspectives. (當警方拘捕和平示威領袖時，這是有助還是有損民主？請從政府及示威者兩方面分析。)

articles.title: South Korea Puzzled After US Suddenly Cuts Back Joint Military Training
articles.summary: South Korea's president and many of its citizens are confused and worried after the United States unexpectedly ordered a big reduction in joint military exercises between the two countries. The two nations have trained together for many decades as allies. US President Donald Trump made the announcement without much warning, leaving South Korean officials struggling to understand what it means for their country's safety. South Korea sits near North Korea, a nation with nuclear weapons, so military cooperation with the US is seen as very important. Experts say the decision could change the balance of power in the whole region of East Asia.

lv1: Which two countries usually train their armies together, according to this news? (根據這則新聞，哪兩個國家通常一起進行軍事訓練？)
Why is military cooperation with the US especially important for South Korea? (為什麼美國與南韓的軍事合作對南韓特別重要？)
lv2: Why might a sudden change in military cooperation between two countries cause worry and confusion? (為何兩國之間的軍事合作突然改變會令人感到擔憂和困惑？)
How could reducing joint military exercises affect the safety of countries in East Asia? (減少聯合軍事演習會如何影響東亞地區各國的安全？)
lv3: Should one country have the power to change a long-standing military agreement without the full agreement of its partner country? What does this say about fairness in international relationships? (一個國家是否應該有權在沒有伙伴國完全同意的情況下改變長期的軍事協議？這反映出國際關係中的公平性問題嗎？)

Some people believe strong military alliances keep the peace, while others argue they create tension. Which view do you find more convincing, and why? (有人認為強大的軍事同盟能維持和平，另一些人則認為這會製造緊張局勢。你認為哪種觀點更具說服力？為什麼？)

articles.title: 香港錄得有記錄以來最高氣溫36.9°C　酷熱下工人保護引關注
articles.summary: 香港天文台於2026年8月9日錄得攝氏36.9度，打破自1884年有紀錄以來的最高溫度紀錄。然而，當日勞工處的「工作暑熱警告」全天維持在最低的黃色級別，未有提升至更高警戒。有意見認為，在如此極端高溫下，現行保護戶外工人的機制未必足夠，業界人士及關注團體呼籲當局檢討制度，確保前線工人在酷熱天氣下得到更佳保障，避免中暑等健康風險。

lv1: 香港在2026年8月9日錄得多少攝氏度的氣溫？
什麼是「工作暑熱警告」？它有什麼作用？
lv2: 為什麼在破紀錄高溫下，「工作暑熱警告」仍停留在黃色級別會令人擔心？
哪些類型的工人最可能在酷熱天氣下面臨健康風險？為什麼？
lv3: 政府在保護戶外工人免受極端天氣傷害方面，應承擔多大責任？僱主又應負上什麼責任？
隨著氣候變化令極端高溫愈來愈頻繁，香港現行的勞工保護法例是否需要作出重大改革？請提出你的論點。

articles.title: 救護車陷入公園地磚　香港公共設施維護問題受關注
articles.summary: 香港西區中山紀念公園昨晚（18日）發生罕見意外，一輛救護車在駛入公園拯救受傷女童期間，車尾輪輾過地磚時突然下陷，令車輛被卡住，無法繼續前進。事件最終需要召來拖車協助脫困，而傷者則由另一輛救護車送往醫院。事件引發外界關注香港公共設施的日常維護質素，以及緊急救援車輛能否順利進入公共空間的問題，促請相關部門定期檢查設施安全。

lv1: 這輛救護車為什麼會被卡在公園裏？
最後是用什麼方法令救護車脫困？
lv2: 如果緊急救援車輛無法順利到達現場，可能會造成什麼嚴重後果？
誰應該負責定期檢查和維修公共設施，以確保安全？
lv3: 香港公共設施的維護責任應由政府、私人承辦商還是市民共同承擔？各方應扮演什麼角色？
這次事件反映出城市基礎設施規劃有何不足之處？政府應如何在城市設計中更好地考慮緊急應變需求？
